sections.title: Agentic AI Foundation Recruits 97 New Members in Q1 — Rapid Growth of Agentic AI Standardization Ecosystem
sections.lead: The Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation recruited a total of 97 new members, including 18 Gold members and 79 Silver members, within three months from January 2026, growing to a cumulative total of 146 member companies.[1][3]
